description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) RELENTLESS ASSAULT (Tacticus Attack Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. SELECT_SHOOTER of the Hellblasters (TACTICUS) opens unit_selected_to_shoot; the card offers the two printed options; a REAL click on "[SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE" spends 1 CP; then they shoot the Flash Gitz (INFANTRY).
